title: Listening and Pronunciation
goal: Train the ear and the voice: from individual sounds to fast natural speech, with word and sentence stress, rhythm, intonation, connected speech, accents and dictation.

modules.title: Listening Foundations
modules.description: Hearing English at its smallest units: individual sounds, single words, short sentences and dialogues, at A1.

lessons.title: Individual Sounds and Words
objectives: Hear the difference between similar sounds (minimal pairs)
Recognise learned words from sound alone
lessons.assessment: Discriminate 12 of 14 minimal pairs and identify 15 of 16 words by ear

lessons.title: Short Sentences
objectives: Understand short spoken sentences without text support
Match spoken sentences to situations
lessons.assessment: Understand 9 of 10 short spoken sentences on first hearing

lessons.title: Dialogues
objectives: Follow 6-10 line everyday dialogues
Identify speakers, setting and purpose
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 questions on everyday dialogues

checkpoint.criteria: Understand sounds, words, sentences and short dialogues by ear

modules.title: The Music of English
modules.description: The prosody system: word stress, sentence stress, connected speech, rhythm and intonation — what makes English sound English.

lessons.title: Word Stress
objectives: Hear and produce stressed syllables in 2-4 syllable words
Recognise stress shifts: PHOtograph → phoTOgrapher
lessons.assessment: Mark and produce correct stress in 12 of 14 words

lessons.title: Sentence Stress and Rhythm
objectives: Hear which words carry meaning in a sentence
Produce the stressed-timed rhythm of English
lessons.assessment: Identify stressed words in 8 sentences and shadow them naturally

checkpoint.criteria: Use word and sentence stress correctly in perception and production

lessons.title: Connected Speech
objectives: Recognise linking, reduction and contractions in fast speech (gonna, wanna, cup of → cuppa)
Understand words that merge together

lessons.title: Rhythm and Intonation
objectives: Hear rising versus falling intonation and what each signals
Use intonation for questions, lists, surprise and boredom
lessons.assessment: Match intonation to meaning in 10 items and produce 4 patterns

checkpoint.criteria: Understand and produce connected speech and meaningful intonation

modules.title: Listening Beyond Basics
modules.description: Extended and varied listening: stories, conversations, natural spoken English, different accents and dictation practice.

lessons.title: Stories
objectives: Follow a 2-3 minute audio story
Track characters and sequence without text
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 questions on an audio story

lessons.title: Conversations
objectives: Follow natural two-person conversations
Track opinions, agreement and topic changes
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 questions including 2 opinion/attitude items

lessons.title: Natural Spoken English
objectives: Handle hesitations, false starts and fillers in real speech
Catch the point despite unknown words
lessons.assessment: Identify main points of 5 natural-speed clips on first listening

checkpoint.criteria: Follow extended stories, conversations and natural speech

lessons.title: Different English Accents
objectives: Recognise the main accent families (British, American, Australian, Indian, others)
Adapt listening to accent variation
lessons.assessment: Understand the same content in 3 different accents with 80 percent accuracy

lessons.title: Dictation
objectives: Write down spoken sentences with accurate spelling and punctuation
Use sound-spelling knowledge to self-correct
lessons.assessment: Transcribe 8 of 10 dictated sentences with at most minor errors

checkpoint.criteria: Listen accurately across accents and transcribe speech correctly

modules.title: Listening Mastery
modules.description: B2-level listening: fast natural speech and strategic comprehension.

lessons.title: Understanding Fast, Natural Speech
objectives: Follow native-speed speech on familiar and new topics
Recover meaning from partial understanding
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 questions on native-speed audio

lessons.title: Comprehension Strategies and Review
objectives: Apply prediction, keyword and inference strategies while listening
Self-assess listening strengths and gaps
lessons.assessment: Apply 3 named strategies on a new audio text and self-assess accurately

checkpoint.criteria: Listen strategically to fast speech and self-assess honestly

exitAssessment.title: Listening and Pronunciation Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Minimal-pair discrimination; word and sentence stress production; connected-speech decoding; comprehension of a native-speed conversation with inference items; comprehension across two accents; dictation of 8 sentences. Pronunciation graded for intelligibility, never for native-likeness.
